name: Duskana, the Rage Mother
oracle_text:
When Duskana enters, draw a card for each creature you control with base power and toughness 2/2.
Whenever a creature you control with base power and toughness 2/2 attacks, it gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature you control with base power and toughness 2/2 attacks, it gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

needs.what: base_power / base_toughness keys in a trigger filter (TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS / matches_card_filter), read through characteristics._base_pt like the effect-side selector, so an `attacks` trigger can match 'a creature you control with base power and toughness 2/2' at the moment it attacks
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_filter_keys carries `power` and `toughness`, but matches_card_filter reads them off the LIVE characteristics (chars(state, oid)), so a 2/2 under an anthem or with a +1/+1 counter would not trigger and a pumped-down bigger creature would; base_power/base_toughness exist only in the effect-side selector_keys. Triggering on every attacker and narrowing the pump's objects (or an `if`/trigger condition) at resolution would put a trigger on the stack for every attacker and check base P/T at the wrong time, which is not the printed trigger condition
